article.title: $20, $30 or $100: Which AI Employee to Hire — Grok Bot vs Claude Duet vs ChatGPT dots

data.text:
One AI employee. Which do you hire?

Grok Bot, $30: a team  that makes calls
Claude Duet, $20: the careful one. You can't get in
ChatGPT dots, $100: won the only independent test

I compared all three, the WIRED test and 25+ posts from daily users ↓ https://t.co/1FR2FIZVNm

OpenAI Dots Pro excludes Switzerland.

I live in Switzerland. I built an agent in Dots anyway. Via Business Premium.

His name is Kurt. He plans my day, checks my inbox, preps meetings and answers club questions.

The launch post said no. The plan details said yes.

Still collecting real Grok Bot use cases while I compare it with Meta Muse and ChatGPT Dots.

This batch: making videos. 4 from October.

First: @anabology built a bot called Claudia that uses Suno, Midjourney and Opus. It made this music video teaser on its own. https://t.co/jAlE6yRjUU
